Nasdaq’s Internship Program is a 10-week summer experience designed to give students real exposure to how global markets and technology come together. Our interns work on meaningful projects alongside Nasdaq teams, gaining hands-on skills that make an impact on the business.
We believe the best way to learn is by doing, that’s why you’ll be paired with a mentor, connected with senior leaders, and included in professional development sessions. You’ll also join a diverse global intern community, sharing experiences and building networks that last beyond the program.
Our goal is to provide a supportive, engaging, and fun environment where your work feels valued and your growth comes first. Check out our Nasdaq Internship Program page to learn more and hear directly from past interns about their journeys.
What You’ll Do
Write quality production-ready code using C#, .Net, .Net Core, Vue.js, MSSQL, PostreSQL, and Terraform
Work with cloud platforms like AWS and build microservices and manage infrastructure using Terraform
Work with a team that leverages automation to streamline the software development lifecycle. This includes automating the build, test, and deployment processes to ensure that code changes are integrated and delivered quickly and reliably.
Review code quality, adhere to coding standards, and align with project requirements
Provide constructive feedback to team members on their code, suggest improvements and best practices
Assist in troubleshooting and debugging issues in the development and production environments
What You’ll Bring
Passion for learning and building innovative solutions
Interest in working with a modern SaaS-based platform
Experience using variety of software development tools and languages, including C#, Vue JS, and/or SQL
Awareness of data-driven systems
Nice-to-Have
Some knowledge of Single Page application development with Vue JS, .NET, and Postgres
Experience or knowledge in building applications leveraging AI
Experience or knowledge of cloud technologies, such as AWS or Azure
Experience or knowledge of no-SQdata stores, such as Elasticsearch
Experience or knowledge of microservices design & development
Experience or knowledge of container technologies, such as Docker
Experience or knowledge of deployment tooling, such as Jenkins
This position will be located in Atlanta and offers the opportunity for a hybrid work environment at least 3 days a week in-office, subject to change, providing flexibility and accessibility for qualified candidates.
Come as You Are
Nasdaq is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and identities.
We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives, experiences, and identities are valued and celebrated.
We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

As a UX/UI Designer Intern at Nelnet, you'll gain hands-on, production-quality experience designing in Figma alongside our UX Design team, contributing to active product and design system work — not just coursework simulations.
Job Responsibilities
Create wireframes, mockups, and prototypes in Figma for active product and design system initiatives.
Apply and help maintain design system components, variables, and styles within Figma files.
Participate in design critiques and reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
Collaborate with UX Designers, and the UX and Accessibility Leads to produce implementation-ready designs.
Learn foundational UX practices: visual hierarchy, typography, responsive design (desktop/tablet/mobile), and basic accessibility considerations (contrast, focus states, touch targets).
Present design work to the team for feedback and iterate based on input.
EDUCATION:
Actively pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Interaction Design, Digital Media, Information Science, or a related field.
EXPERIENCE:
No professional experience required.
Portfolio or coursework demonstrating Figma proficiency preferred.
COMPETENCIES – SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES:
Working proficiency in Figma (components, auto layout; variables a plus).
Foundational understanding of visual design principles: typography, color, layout, hierarchy.
Willingness to give and receive design feedback in a team setting.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Curiosity about accessible and inclusive design.
Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple small design tasks concurrently.

Nelnet is a diversified and innovative company committed to enriching lives through the power of service as a student loan servicer, professional services company, consumer loan originator and servicer, payments processor, renewable energy solutions, and K-12 and higher education expert.
For over 40 years, Nelnet has been serving its customers, associates, and communities.
The perks of working at Nelnet go beyond our benefits package. When you join the Nelnet team, you're part of a community invested in the success of each individual. That support comes through in our work, as we are united by our mission of creating opportunities for people where they live, learn, and work.
As a UX/UI Front-End Engineer Intern at Nelnet, you'll gain hands-on experience maintaining the Unifi Design System's documentation site (unifi.nelnet.io) and help convert its content into machine-readable context for AI-assisted development tooling. You'll work alongside our team of engineers and designers to learn how a design system is maintained and documented at enterprise scale.
Job Responsibilities
Help maintain content on the Unifi documentation site (unifi.nelnet.io), primarily updating existing documentation to align with the current state of the design system.
Assist in converting design and accessibility guidelines content into machine-readable formats to support AI-assisted development workflows.
Perform front-end maintenance work on the documentation site (Angular).
Participate in code reviews and follow version control practices (Git).
EDUCATION:
Actively pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
EXPERIENCE:
Coursework or personal project experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Angular required — this role involves maintenance work in an existing Angular codebase, not first exposure to the framework.
No professional/paid experience required.
COMPETENCIES – SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/ABILITIES:
Working proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Angular.
Interest in developer experience, technical documentation, and AI-assisted tooling.
Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
Strong written communication skills.
Comfortable asking questions and receiving feedback.
Basic understanding of, or interest in, web accessibility (WCAG) a plus.
Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, HSA and FSA, generous earned time off, 401K/student loan repayment, life insurance & AD&D insurance, employee assistance program, employee stock purchase program, tuition reimbursement, performance-based incentive pay, short- and long-term disability, and a robust wellness program. posting.description:
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
At Air Manufacturing Innovation (Air MI), we deliver on Nike’s most daring dream: giving every athlete the unparalleled sensation of walking on air. Since Nike introduced the Air sole in 1979, no technology has become more synonymous with Nike than Air. Our teams engineer, make and perfect Nike’s most advanced footwear components. Masters of teamwork, we challenge assumptions in order to get faster, drive efficiency and fine-tune technology to deliver quality performance plastic. At our state-of-the-art facilities, Air MI is taking Air to places that we never thought possible.
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
As our Air MI Engineering Intern, you will join the Air MI team to assist in the manufacturing of products related to Nike Air Footwear.
The available position may focus on process development, machine optimization, or other related projects. You will be mentored by your area-specific and cross- functional teammates and use your engineering skills to implement product development or continuous improvement solutions as determined by the project(s) to which you are assigned. Alongside your engineering teammates, you may work with other specialists including but not limited to areas such as development, production, costing, maintenance and facilities.
WHAT YOU WILL EXPERIENCE:
In the NIKE, Inc. Summer Internship Program, you’ll contribute to high-priority, real business initiatives that align with the NIKE, Inc. strategic roadmap.
With the guidance of senior leaders and experienced managers, you’ll take ownership of a project that’s been scoped to drive impact. These projects are designed to challenge your critical thinking, further develop your skills and foster effective collaboration while contributing directly to your team’s goals.
This is a 10-week paid internship opportunity with relocation assistance. Curious to know what it’s like to be part of a world-class Internship Program? Check out our recap video from last summer:
Nike Internship Program Recap Video
WHAT YOU BRING:
Qualifications
Enrolled in an undergraduate program with an expected graduation date of December 2027 or Spring 2028
Preferred degrees: Mechanical, Chemical, Plastics, Electrical, Industrial or Manufacturing Engineering or similar field
Strong desire to work in a manufacturing environment required
Resume submission (PDF) required
Skills
Experience in a high-volume and/or high mix manufacturing environment is preferred
Ability to analyze problems, assess data, use basic math and statistics, and deal with ambiguity and frequent changes in priorities
Ability to balance multiple challenging projects simultaneously
Must be comfortable working hands-on
Exposure to Six Sigma/Lean manufacturing principles and concepts
Mynext: Be Empowered to Grow within Nike and Create the Future
This internship – as well as full-time positions – are located within Nike’s Air Manufacturing Innovation (Air MI) facility in Beaverton, OR. Interns should have a strong interest in manufacturing environments and be comfortable spending the majority of their time working on-site within a fast-paced production setting rather than a traditional corporate office environment.
We offer a number of accommodations to complete our interview process including screen readers, sign language interpreters, accessible and single location for in-person interviews, closed captioning, and other reasonable modifications as needed. If you discover, as you navigate our application process, that you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please complete the
Candidate Accommodation Request Form
.

We work across industries and continents to conserve water resources and develop cleaner chemistries that help minimize environmental impact. We take action every day as only NIKE can to move the world forward through sport and help every athlete* thrive. We do this by driving our enterprise mandate for sustainability and compliance across climate and environment, people and human rights, foundational expectations, marketplace and supply chain.
*If you have a body, you are an athlete.

posting.description:
Who we are:
As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be.
QTS' summer internship program will provide you first hand experience into the fast paced world of the data center industry by providing weekly lunch and learns, a comprehensive orientation program, site based activities, socials and volunteering events. Every intern will be assigned initiatives tied to real QTS objectives helping with anything pertaining to the whole life-cycle of a data center build and/or company operations.
The intern will support the Enterprise Data & Analytics team by developing a Tableau Usage and Adoption Analytics solution that provides visibility into how analytics content is being consumed across the organization.
This project will help identify trends in dashboard usage, opportunities to improve adoption, and areas where reporting assets may be consolidated, enhanced, or retired. The work will provide valuable insights that help maximize the value of the organization's analytics investments while improving the overall user experience.
The intern will work closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, and business stakeholders to define metrics, analyze usage patterns, build visualizations, and present recommendations to leadership.
Responsibilities
Analyze Tableau usage and adoption data
Define and document key adoption and engagement metrics
Develop data models and KPI calculations
Design and build Tableau dashboards and visualizations
Identify trends in user engagement and dashboard utilization
Document insights and recommendations for improving self-service analytics adoption
Present findings and recommendations to analytics leadership and stakeholders
Create supporting documentation and knowledge transfer materials
Expected Deliverables
By the end of the internship, the candidate will deliver:
Tableau Usage & Adoption Dashboard
Usage and engagement KPI framework
Dashboard/content inventory and utilization analysis
Adoption trend reporting
Recommendations for improving analytics adoption and content effectiveness
Executive presentation summarizing key findings and opportunities
Documentation supporting ongoing maintenance and enhancement

Actively pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Management, Economics, Mathematics, Accounting, Finance, STEM, Data Science, Human Resources, or a related field.

Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
Must be a US Citizen

About Futureforce University Recruiting
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.
Job Category
Fixed Term & Temporary
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
POSITION TITLE: Summer 2027 Intern - Sales Development, Nonprofit
LOCATION: Chicago Office
OBJECTIVE:
This role is designed for a high-performing student interested in a career in software sales.
INTERNSHIP DESCRIPTION:
We hire outstanding people who thrive in diverse environments, have a passion for technology innovation, place high expectations on themselves, understand the importance of execution, and seek an environment where their talents can drive industry change.
ROLE DESCRIPTION:
This role serves as the entry-level role into a client-facing sales career at Salesforce and is designed to be your first look into how we sell Salesforce products. In this role, you will support a team of Sales/Business Development Representatives (SDR/BDR) for Nonprofit prospects and customers.
Alongside your responsibilities, you will be trained in core competencies with the goal to build the skills of a client-facing, inbound Sales Development Representative (SDR). Successful Sales Interns are able to think critically and learn through coaching from their mentors, which helps them to build upon and improve their skills throughout their tenure in this role. After demonstrating the competencies necessary to successfully execute the role, we will work together to build a candidacy for the SDR role based upon your success in this program.
This role requires 4 days in the office a week.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES:
Inbound Qualification: Vet inbound leads from marketing campaigns, events, and website traffic using the Customer 360 platform.
Outbound Prospecting: Generate pipeline across multiple segments through cold calling, email outreach, and social media engagement.
Partner Lead Management: Nurture and qualify Partner Leads (PLs) in collaboration with consulting partners to ensure a seamless sales funnel progression.
Sales Collaboration: Partner with SDRs and Sales Executives to drive interest, and schedule discovery meetings.
Account Research: Identify key contacts within target accounts and develop personalized outreach strategies.
CRM Hygiene: Track all prospecting activities within Salesforce to ensure timely follow-ups and accurate lead conversion data.
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
Current Junior/rising Senior graduating May 2028, pursuing a Bachelor’s degree with a preferred concentration in Business /Information Systems or equivalent.
Strong academic background and performance
Preferred prior working experience (can include part-time or over school breaks)
Strong communication, networking, and presenting skills
Able to work independently with minimal supervision whilst producing tangible results
Adaptable to change and enjoys learning in a fast-paced environment
Superior attention to detail
Strategic thinker with a bias toward action
Team player with a willingness to go above and beyond to deliver excellence
Able to work with collaboration tools: Slack, Google Suite, Salesforce technologies knowledge a plus
Long-term interest in a Software Sales role.
Passion for technology - learning new domains and specialized areas. You don’t have to be a Salesforce expert, but you should be willing to learn about our product, our sales process, and the tools/methodologies Sales need to excel.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
be your best
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
do your best
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this
Accommodations Request Form
.

Candidate Privacy Statement
for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Salesforce offers a variety of benefits to help you live well including: time off programs, medical, dental, vision, mental health support, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and an employee stock purchasing program. More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: https://www.salesforcebenefits.com.

Job Description
Why Join Us?
At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our co-op program is designed to be a strategic pipeline for future leadership talent. Students who demonstrate exceptional performance, leadership potential, and alignment with our values will be considered for full-time opportunities during their co-op with us to begin post-graduation. These opportunities include potential placement into one of our Leadership Development Programs (LDPs) or other early career roles across the organization.
As a global company with opportunities spanning multiple businesses, functions, and locations, applicants are required to be geographically flexible and mobile for both their co-op assignment and potential future employment opportunities. Potential placement into co-op, LDP, or full-time roles is based on business needs and organizational priorities at the time of selection. Onsite and in-office work is an essential function of this role and a requirement of the position.
Strategic Business Impact
For this role, projects may include the following responsibilities:
Support day-to-day activities and projects across the team, working with various stakeholders as needed.
Assist with data collection, analysis, documentation, and general process improvement initiatives.
Contribute to cross-functional projects while gaining exposure to business operations.
Compensation & Relocation
Our Undergraduate co-ops offer an hourly rate between $18.50 - $28.75 dependent upon the role type and location you are supporting (aligned to respective cost-of-living guidelines). If eligible, a relocation stipend is offered in the amount of $5,000. Students must be located 50+ miles away from the physical location of the internship to be eligible for the relocation stipend. Please note that interns are required to have a reliable mode of transportation to and from their assigned work location for the duration of their co-op.
What We Look For
Academic Background & Work Experience:
Undergraduate student completing a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related between December 2027 – June 2029.
Previous related co-ops, internships, and / or work experience preferred.
Leadership Profile:
· Proven leadership experience through student organizations, athletics, Greek life, community service, volunteer organizations, campus programs, military service, or other leadership roles.
· A track record of influencing others, leading initiatives, driving results, and creating positive impact within teams and organizations.
· Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and solve complex problems.
· Evidence of grit, resilience, and perseverance when facing challenges, setbacks, or competing priorities.
· Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and an innovative mindset.
· Excellent interpersonal communication skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to build relationships across diverse teams.
· Geographic mobility and flexibility required to pursue internship and future career opportunities in locations aligned with business needs.
· Onsite and in-office work is an essential function of this role and is required throughout the program and in future placements to support collaboration across businesses, functions, and locations.
If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!
To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require sponsorship (current or future) for employment visa status. Thermo Fisher does not offer employment in this position to holders of F-1, J-1, H-1, OPT, and CPT Visas for the purpose of obtaining practical experience.

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. Claim
Compensation Overview
The hourly salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual hourly rate for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

$25.00 - $26.00
Target Openings
2
What Is the Opportunity?
Applications for this posting will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. now and in the future. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT for this role. The Travelers Claim Intern program provides qualified candidates an excellent opportunity to gain first-hand business experience, receive valuable on-the-job training, contact clients, determine coverage, scoping of losses and completing damage estimates. We are seeking applicants who are interested about entering the insurance industry and who are excited about the prospect of making Claim their future career choice. Housing assistance is not provided.
What Will You Do?
Structured onboarding to Travelers systems and protocols.
Exposure to Personal and Business Insurance claims of basic to moderate complexity.
Learn and understand effective strategies for investigating, negotiating and resolving claims thoroughly, accurately and efficiently.
Develop knowledge of what happened, estimating damage, determining what coverages apply and helping our customers through the process through strong verbal and written communication skills.
Observe the work of the Claim Professional through desk and "ride-alongs" with experienced employees.
Work with a designated manager/mentor to develop knowledge of claims through core assignments.
Develop a strong foundation of customer service, analytical and problem-solving skills.
Complete challenging and meaningful project work.
Perform other duties as assigned.
What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?
Preferred cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above.
Suggested college majors include Business Administration, Liberal Arts (with business focus preferred), Business Management, Risk Management and Insurance or a business-related discipline.
Knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Obtained or pursuing a Bachelor’s degree.

email

Thornton Tomasetti
applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world’s challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. We provide support and opportunities to our employees to achieve their full potential and cultivate a rewarding career.
Our
Building Envelope
team provides consulting services to architects, building owners, and developers for new and existing buildings. Our suite of specialists help solve complex design challenges, improve constructability, maximize energy efficiency, and repair and rehabilitate existing systems. We offer a range of services over the full building life cycle to help clients execute ambitious visions to design, build, and maintain their properties. Our consulting services include materials research, specialty analyses, detailed design, engineering and construction support, as well as condition assessments, investigations, and restoration.
Your Role
As a Building Envelope Intern in our Restoration & Renewal Practice, you will gain hands-on experience evaluating and improving the performance of building envelopes and interior systems for a variety of restoration, renovation and adaptive reuse projects. You will work alongside experienced architects and engineers in a dynamic, collaborative environment, learning practical solutions. This Co-Op is for Spring 2027.
What You’ll Do
Assist in field inspections and data collection for building envelopes and architectural systems.
Support assessments of system performance, code compliance and feasibility studies for renovations, and restoration design.
Help prepare technical documentation, including drawings, specifications and reports for project teams and clients.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to develop practical, constructible solutions.
What You’ll Bring
Current undergraduate or graduate student pursuing a degree in Architecture.
Strong academic record and interest in building performance, envelope design, and renovation projects.
Experience with Revit, AutoCAD, or architectural detailing tools is a plus but not required.
Compensation
The rate for this position generally is $21 - $36 hourly. This range is a good faith estimate provided pursuant to the Massachusetts Equal Pay for Equal Work Act and Equal Pay Transparency Rules. Similar positions located outside of Massachusetts will not necessarily receive the same compensation. Actual pay rates may vary from the range, as permitted by Massachusetts Equal Pay Transparency Law. Compensation offers will be based on various factors, including operational needs, individual education, qualifications and experience, work location and comparison to employee already in the role, as well as other considerations permitted by law.
